articles.title: DeepEvalの公式Jev対応でjudgeを判定特化モデル「Jev」に置き換えて検出力・安定性・コストを比べてみる
articles.timestampEvidence: Embedded datePublished, independently matched public RSS pubDate
facts: DeepEval 4.2.6 has llm/hybrid/system_one evaluation modes; TypeSafeModel passed as system_one_model.
system_one uses bundled questions; JevEval instead supplies custom Noul/Score/Choice questions.
Six cases, three metrics, three repeats. evaluate() wall time and evaluation_cost sum; grounded and standard definitions have different expectation denominators.
With reasons: Jev 0.46 seconds and USD 0.000330, compared judge 4.39 seconds and USD 0.089058. Separate no-reason run: 0.47 versus 3.21 seconds. Do not mix these conditions.
Faithfulness checks support versus contradiction depending on mode; a correct preface caused a 0.7-threshold false rejection. Japanese generalization and latency-outlier cause are unverified.

articles.title: Kiro Web にローカルの .kiro 設定をアップロードしてみた
articles.timestampEvidence: Embedded datePublished and public RSS pubDate
facts: Upload local configuration to cloud is one-way import, separate from applying cloud settings to new local sessions.
Uploading the entire ~/.kiro directory was rejected; the author imported supported child directories such as steering, settings, skills and agents.
The author's eight steering files imported; some custom-agent PDF files exceeded the observed 4 MB upload limit.
Imported MCP settings retained local executable paths and failed during use. Successful configuration import did not establish executable dependency portability.
The author observed limitations in explicitly selecting custom agents in Kiro Web; no successful end-to-end equivalence with the local setup was demonstrated.
